answer: Locks are written down in lantern, expire in wharf, and vertex lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 47 aliases therefore needs 148 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 612 identities would post 2963 proofs and burn roughly 55 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
